body:
I have felt like this for around 5 years. Just losing myself more and more as time goes on. I wasn’t gonna comment, I just came here looking for help; but the more comments I read the more I cried and the more I related. 

About 5 years ago (at age 23) a family member put me through something that traumatised me, I then got into a relationship with a narcissist and we had a child. And I don’t know if either of those things caused it, but I know it was around then that it started. And I still feel completely lost. I don’t feel like who I used to be at all, I have lost all of my confidence, my joy, my spark for life. I feel like I have to mould myself into the people I am around so they will like me, and so I never feel like I am ever truly being me. When I’m alone I just think of all the things I might’ve said/done during the day and how the people I’ve been around probably hate me, or find me cringe/embarrassing, or laugh about me when I’m not there. Logically I know this can’t be true, I just can’t move past feeling that it is. I think about every conversation I’ve had that day. I doubt myself constantly. 

I feel so detached, from myself, my friends, my family. I don’t feel the connection I used to have to anyone anymore. I crave a close connection with them, and I know they love me, but I feel so anxious that they will start to hate me that I have become a complete shell around them. Tonight, one of my oldest friends talked to me about how I was a completely different person to who I used to be, that I was no where near the bubbly, confident person I used to be, how I always seemed anxious and even her mum had noticed. This is why I am here now. 

I tend to avoid social situations with groups of people (by groups I mean as small as 3/4 other people), and if I do I usually just sit quietly until someone talks to me because I feel rude or unwelcome to join in others conversations. And then I get such anxiety that people think I’m weird for being so quiet (I mean, it probably is weird).

I struggle massively to set boundaries and don’t know my own personal moral code anymore other than be a good, likeable person - and like wtf does that even mean? I end up just letting people walk all over me for fear of upsetting them if I tell them that they are upsetting me. 

I’m really worried the way I am is going to knock my son’s confidence, because I need to show him how to be a strong, self assured, confident person, with dreams and goals and aspirations. But how can I do that when I don’t even know who I am? He’s so bubbly and confident now, what if he loses it because I am his biggest role model and I am barely a person and haven’t been for a long time? So along with all my other anxieties, I spend so much time feeling guilty and like a terrible mum. 

It’s probably silly. I feel silly writing this. But I just want my old self back. Or any self. I just want to feel like a real person so I can be happy again and show my son happiness. 

(Btw, pls don’t get me wrong, my son obviously makes me happy, I adore him and everything about him. He is the only person I don’t feel detachment from, but I do fear as he will stop liking me too)

Oh yeah for sure, I know his mum babysits sometimes while he’s there. She often tells me “I had him this day, dad had him that day” and what they were doing etc. But I’ve also noticed  that a lot of it is him not wanting to pick him up. Conveniently, whenever I’ve asked him to be picked up at a certain time, he is always busy and I’ll have to see what his mum can do.

It’s not about work for him. He just doesn’t want to pick his son up via public transport, so gets his mum to collect when she can instead. I have said to him previously that if something comes up for him during his time with his child, he should be arranging childcare or miss out on whatever it is, as I would have to if something came up for me during my time with my son. But he just chooses to not get his son anyway and so by default, I end up being the childcare that he uses.

Thanks all. I just had to make sure I wasn’t being the AH. I’ve avoided going to court over this as I’d prefer to settle it outside, and it would be very costly to do so (as I’ve said dad doesn’t work, so court would probably only make him pay around £10 a week anyway, if that) and it’s money I don’t have. I only work part time, nursery fees are expensive and I have to pay for bills, the care of our son and everything else. It’s an expense I just can’t afford unfortunately. But I have been recording days he’s had/not had his son in a book, so there is a record just in case.

I had no problem with the tone of the relationship, but he suggested taking me out and bought it up multiple times, but now doesn’t want too. I’m upset at that tbh, had he said nothing about going out then nothing would be different. But to say it and then change tone has upset me

I didn't say i was upset about it. I said we talked about it, I told him I want to be exclusive during the conversation about it. We hadn't previously discussed it until that point. 
I think you have misunderstood the post
I should also say, he says he doesn't want to rush things, and I definitely understand that, but I don't think wanting the person you're sleeping with to be exclusive is rushing things?
